raw.details:
HackSmart 2.0: An Opportunity to Reimagine Mobility

HackSmart is back for its second edition!

Organized by Battery Smart X Geek Room, HackSmart 2.0 brings together developers, students, and innovators to build practical solutions for real-world challenges in electric mobility.

From battery swapping and operational efficiency to automation and technology-driven solutions, the hackathon provides an opportunity to collaborate, innovate, and solve industry challenges.

New challenges. Fresh ideas. Bigger possibilities.

Event Details

  • Organizer: Battery Smart & Geek Room
  • Venue: Battery Smart Office, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana
  • Format: Offline Hackathon
  • Registration Period: 7 November – 15 December 2026
  • Hackathon Dates: To Be Announced

How to Register

  • Register through the official HackSmart 2.0 listing on Unstop.
  • Fill in your personal and professional details.
  • Enter your team details, Individual registrations are also accepted.

Hackathon Structure

Registration & Shortlisting

Applications will be reviewed by the organizing team. Shortlisted participants will receive further details regarding the hackathon schedule and participation guidelines.

Kickoff & Build Sprint

Selected teams will attend an orientation covering the problem statements, evaluation criteria, and event guidelines before beginning the development phase.

Mentors will be available to provide technical guidance and feedback.

Project Demonstration

Teams will present their solutions to the jury through a 10-minute demonstration, showcasing their approach, implementation, and potential impact.

The top five teams will advance to the final round.

Final Jury Pitch

The top five teams will present their solutions in a 7-minute final pitch, followed by evaluation and winner announcements.

Evaluation Criteria

Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, scalability, and relevance to real-world mobility challenges.

Join HackSmart 2.0!

Bring your ideas, collaborate with fellow builders, and contribute to the future of electric mobility.

Register now and get ready to build!
